citation: Förste et al. (2014), GFZ Data Services, DOI 10.5880/icgem.2015.1
gravityDisturbance: total model gravity minus normal gravity on WGS84 ellipsoid h=0; mGal; rounded to 0.1 mGal
geoid: model equipotential surface relative to WGS84 ellipsoid, using boule.WGS84 reference potential; meters; rounded to 0.01 m
display: interpolated model grid with centered color scales; potato radius displacement = N * visual exaggeration
limitation: Global field is shown separately from the existing local normal-gravity and height calculation. Not observed Bouguer anomaly or terrain mass correction.
